list.name: user_email
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['user.email'] FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND LogAttributes['user.email'] != '' ORDER BY LogAttributes['user.email']

list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['session.id'] FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT LogAttributes['session.id']) AS sessions FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])), 4) AS total_cost FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT round(avg(session_cost), 4) AS avg_cost FROM (SELECT LogAttributes['session.id'] AS sid, sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])) AS session_cost FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY sid)

SELECT sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS total_tokens FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT count() AS api_calls FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS avg_latency_ms FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS time, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])), 5) AS cost_usd FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS time, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens'])) AS input_tokens, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS output_tokens, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens'])) AS cache_read FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool, count() AS uses FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.tool_decision' AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Tool Accept Rate
panels.description: % of tool decisions that were accepted

targets.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS tool, round(countIf(LogAttributes['decision'] = 'accept') / count() * 100, 1) AS accept_rate FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.tool_decision' AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY tool HAVING count() >= 3 ORDER BY accept_rate ASC LIMIT 15

SELECT toStartOfHour(Timestamp) AS time, countIf(LogAttributes['decision'] = 'accept') AS accepted, countIf(LogAttributes['decision'] != 'accept') AS rejected FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.tool_decision' AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Session Summary — Click to filter timeline below

targets.rawSql: SELECT LogAttributes['session.id'] AS session_id, LogAttributes['user.email'] AS user, any(LogAttributes['model']) AS model, count() AS api_calls, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])), 4) AS total_cost, sum(toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens'])) AS total_tokens, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])), 0) AS avg_latency_ms, round(dateDiff('second', min(Timestamp), max(Timestamp)) / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min, min(Timestamp) AS started_at FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY session_id, user ORDER BY started_at DESC

SELECT Timestamp AS time, LogAttributes['model'] AS model, toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) AS input_tokens, toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens']) AS output_tokens, toInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens']) AS cache_read, round(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd']), 5) AS cost_usd, round(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms']), 0) AS latency_ms FROM otel_logs WHERE Body = 'claude_code.api_request' AND match(LogAttributes['user.email'], '${user_email:regex}') AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session_id:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp ASC
